newsitem.title: USA: MCI expands bundled service to businesses.
newsitem.headline: MCI expands bundled service to businesses.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp on Thursday said it expanded its MCI One communications services package to the business market, with more than 20 services available on a single bill under the name network MCI One.
The service is available immediately in Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Detroit, Hartford, Milwaukee, New York, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, Portland and Seattle, MCI said.
Services bundled include local, long distance and international calling, paging, Internet, cellular, data, conferencing, toll free services, calling cards and E-mail.
"No other company offers so many communications services and consolidates them on one single bill," said Brian Brewer, MCI senior vice president of business marketing.

MCI said its offering will be extended as its wireless footprint expands. So far MCI relies on reselling cellular services through its Nationwide Cellular unit, which will give it coverage of 34 cities by the end of 1996.

But a deal last month with NextWave Telecom Inc will allow MCI access to 110 million potential customers in 63 cities with Personal Communications Services (PCS), which promise broader services on tiny phones with better battery life.
MCI launched MCI One for consumers in April.
MCI said that it expects bundled services to yield greater customer stability and thus higher revenues by offering users increasing discounts the more MCI services they take.
"Churn" or rapid customer turnover, is the bane of the industry, causing marketing costs to soar and spurring competition on price.

To fight this MCI said it is introducing networkMCI Fund, a special account for large business that sign a term agreement. Customers using it will be able to choose from a broad selection of MCI services and products with no out-of- pocket investment. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
